News Corp Australia Extends Digital Lead in August – Audience of 16.6 Million and 78 Per Cent Adult Reach

September 22, 2026

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:50
Instaread

Ipsos iris August 2026 rankings, released today, confirm that News Corp Australia continues to set the pace as thenation’s leading news and information publisher, reaching 78.1 per cent of online adults.

In August, 16.616 million people visited News Corp Australia’s sites – widening the market-leading gap to 2.9 million visitors ahead of its nearest competitor. This scale was matched by deep audience engagement, with an average of 143 browser page views per person and more than 83.9 million video views for the month.

In the News category, News Corp Australia was the top news and information publisher in August, delivering:  

  • An audience of 12.71 million and 510 million browser page views (PVs)
  • An engaged reach of 40 average browser PVs per person
  • An average of 52 minutes spent per person across the company’s news sites
  • 67 million video views
  • Six of the company’s news brands sit in the top 25 – News.com.au (audience of 10.49 million) and News24 (2.17 million), along with subscription led sites The Australian (3.11 million), Herald Sun (2.96 million), The Daily Telegraph (2.78 million) and The Courier-Mail (2.38 million).  

Managing Director and Publisher Free News and Lifestyle Pippa Leary said: “Reaching nearly four in five Australian adults and widening our competitive lead to 2.9 million reflects the strength and scale of our network. From news.com.au delivering more than twice the engaged reach of its nearest competitor to video consumption expanding across our network, we are consistently delivering the trusted environments and engagement our clients look for.”

August 2026 highlights include: 

  • News.com.au delivered 295 million browser PVs and an engaged reach of 28 average browser PVs per person, up 1.62 per cent on last month and more than double that of the closest competitor
    • Consumers spent an average of 33 minutes per person on news.com.au
    • Video views totalled 49 million
    • News.com.au – Travel led the travel news category with an audience of 2.36 million and 12.7 million browser PVs
  • Taste.com.au deliveredan audience of 3.91 million and 52.3 million browser PVs
    • Engaged reach of 13 average browser PVs per person
    • Video views totalled 1.2 million 

Ipsos iris is Australia’s digital audience measurement currency endorsed by the Interactive Advertising Bureau (IAB), the trade association for online advertising in Australia, providing accurate data about the 21 million Australians aged 18+ who access a wide variety of digital content and services across Smartphone, PC/Laptop and Tablet devices.  

Source: Ipsos iris Online Audience Measurement Service July 2026 – August 2026, Age 18+, PC/Laptop, Smartphone, Tablet, Text Only, Organisation, News Organisation, Brand Group, News excluding Weather Subcategory & Aggregators, Lifestyle, Sports, Audience (000s), Audience Reach %, Engagement based on AVG Mins PP, Browser Page Views (MM), *Based on Avg. Browser PVs pp, Video Audience (000s), Video Views (MM).
